justification: Critical: a production data load (migration 095, 43 DCP controls, applied), a prepared law-text refresh and flag clearance (dq88 script + migration 096, to be applied by the owner), and a changed outreach check (OC-17).

pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-142 read 70 after #1248; 9 councils' housing chapters were registered PDFs never extracted. DQ-88 read 30: the monitor was blind 2026-06-08 to 2026-10-07 and its first good run flagged every changed instrument.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: OC-17's per-council split still counted Inner West LEP rows that DQ-114 moved to DQ-140 on 2026-10-09, so the two totals disagreed (240 vs 0) and OC-17 failed on its own consistency check.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Controls follow the 092 shape; the generator gains a PDF-page quote check against dcp_chapter_registry.r2_public_pdf_url. The law refresh follows the 2026-09-15 method (version history rows, never delete).
pre_impl.external_source_error: Every control quote is checked on its registered PDF page and every figure (with unit) in its quote; every new law passage was checked verbatim in today's in-force text before the refresh was written.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change; the site reads the same control and provision columns as before.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without 095 the building-area figure is withheld for these councils; without the refresh, repealed SEPP text (s 2.27) keeps being served as current.

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/outreach_scoped_councils.py ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142 ; python -m pytest tests/test_dq142_build_controls_migration.py -q -o addopts=
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The OC-17 split stops matching DQ-114 (LEP rows counted again), a council with undecided LEP scope is published, or 095's rows are removed (DQ-142 back to 70).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: before this change outreach_scoped_councils.py failed with 'split counts 240 keys but DQ-114 counts 0'; after it passes with inner_west unlisted for DQ-140 1108. 095: the first pass refused 7 (two second-limb rules, five unit forms the check did not read: '900 millimetres', '6.0 metres'); the check was widened and the rules re-quoted, then 43 verified. DQ-142 70 -> 29. The dq88 refresh dry run refused twice (non-breaking spaces after clause numbers; a fragment with no '2.27') before passing: retired 7, edited 5, 0 repealed passages left.

functions.name: compute
functions.input: a database connection and the published list's stated scope exceptions read from the shared JSON
functions.output: per council the reasons it cannot be listed (DQ-114, DQ-140, no_config, DQ-115) and any consistency problems
functions.if_none: A council with no reasons is listed; an unreachable database is UNKNOWN, never a pass.

functions.name: pdf_page_text
functions.input: a council slug, its registered chapter key and a one-based PDF page number from a finding
functions.output: that page's text, whitespace-normalised and lowercased, read from the chapter's registered PDF
functions.if_none: None when the chapter has no PDF or the page is out of range, so the finding is refused.

values.value: 43 DCP building-area controls for 12 councils (setbacks, landscaped area, deep soil)
values.source: each council's registered DCP chapter PDF, quoted per row with page and section
values.if_missing: The arithmetic withholds the footprint; no figure is invented.

queries.purpose: LEP rules with undecided scope per council (DQ-140)
queries.where_clause: rp.is_current AND rp.v2_is_actionable AND rp.source_council IS NOT NULL AND document_type = 'LEP'

break_it.scenario: A council's DCP rows are clean but its LEP scope is undecided
break_it.what_happens: It stays off the published list with reason 'DQ-140 n'
break_it.how: _LEP_SQL adds DQ-140 as a delisting reason

break_it.scenario: A reader's quote is paraphrased or from another page
break_it.what_happens: Refused: the fragment is not on the named PDF page
break_it.how: pdf_page_text plus a normalised substring check

break_it.scenario: A rule applies to a housing type only through a sentence on another page
break_it.what_happens: That sentence is quoted with its own page ('pdf:N') and checked too

break_it.scenario: Flags are cleared before the repealed text is removed
break_it.what_happens: Migration 096 refuses: its first assertion finds the repealed passages still current

break_it.scenario: The refresh's old passage is missing or appears twice in a row
break_it.what_happens: The script refuses and names the row; nothing is written
break_it.how: exactly-once check per edit, then a sweep for any repealed text still current

post_merge.manual_verify: Owner runs: python scripts/dq88_refresh_2026_10_10.py --apply ; python scripts/apply_migration_dry_run.py migrations/096_dq88_clear_reviewed_instruments.sql --apply ; then python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-88 reads 3. Migration 095 is already applied (DQ-142 29).
